# Emblor v2 `2.0.0-alpha.1`

This prerelease improves typing performance for large tag lists. Draft input changes no longer rerender committed tag parts when consumers keep their committed values and children stable.

The release preserves the v2 headless compound API and supports React 18 and React 19. Install it from the prerelease channel:

```bash
npm install emblor@next
```

`latest` remains the Emblor v1 line.
